admin-login.error.blocked.description: Too many attempts for this username, when the server did not say how long to wait.

admin-login.error.blockedFor.defaultMessage: Muitas tentativas. Tente novamente em {minutes, number, ::group-off} min.
admin-login.error.blockedFor.description: Too many attempts for this username. {minutes} is the wait, rounded up to whole minutes. Safe to show: the budget is keyed on the username the caller typed.

admin-login.error.captchaRequired.defaultMessage: Verificação de segurança não concluída. Tente novamente.
admin-login.error.captchaRequired.description: The sign-in was refused because the Turnstile check on the form was missing or not accepted. The widget is reset when this shows, so a second attempt has a fresh challenge.

admin-login.error.failed.description: Sign-in refused, or a field left empty. The server refuses an unknown user, a wrong password and a deactivated account identically, so this must not tell them apart.

admin-login.error.offline.defaultMessage: Não foi possível completar o login. Verifique a conexão e tente novamente.
admin-login.error.offline.description: Any other sign-in failure, including a lost connection.

admin-login.heading.description: Heading of the administrator sign-in page.

admin-login.lede.description: Line under the sign-in heading. The page is reachable only over the team's private network.

admin-login.noscript.description: Shown with JavaScript disabled: signing in is an API call the page's script makes.

admin-login.reveal.description: Accessible name of the icon button that shows the typed password. Fixed: whether the password is shown is announced through aria-pressed, so this must not change to "hide".

admin-login.title.description: Browser tab title of the administrator sign-in page. {appTitle} is the application's name.

admin-login.username.description: Label of the username field. An administrator's username is either a plain handle or an email address.
